about: The Daily's 'I didn't know that' pool. Every entry carries the source's name, a link a reader can open, the date the source was read, and the source's own words the fact rests on. An entry without them is never shown (scripts/daily_fact.py, test/daily-email-v2.test.mjs). The old quote pool (data/quote-pool.json) stays off. Each entry has one category from the list in scripts/daily_fact.py (CATEGORIES); the day's pick comes from a fixed schedule that never repeats a fact until the pool is used up and never shows one category two days running. New entries come in with scripts/daily_fact.py --import, which stamps the day they may first show ('added') so the days already sent never change.
